entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' for product help or 'Sales' for new orders.
Support.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I need to process a return for a VeloBand GPS Tracker I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you please provide me with your order number?
Sure, it's VF886-015B.

Thank you. I see the order here. It looks like it was delivered about 30 days ago. Before we proceed, could you tell me a bit about the reason for the return? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?
It's not a technical issue, the band works fine. The thing is, I actually tried to return this much earlier, about three weeks ago. I was well within the initial window.
Okay, and what happened when you tried to process the return then?

Well, that's the problem. There must have been a major website error. Every time I tried to access the returns portal, the entire system was down. I just kept getting a 'service unavailable' message and couldn't print the return label. I even took a screenshot of the error page because I was worried this might happen.

I understand completely, and I sincerely apologize for that frustration. Let me check my internal notes... ah, yes. I do see a record of a service outage affecting our returns portal around that time. It was a known issue on our end.
Okay, good. So you can see I did try to do this on time.

Yes, absolutely. Thank you for your patience with that. Let me just pull up our official return policy... Okay, it looks like you're unfortunately outside the return period. Our policy states you have 10 days from the delivery date.
Oh, 10 days? That's great. I thought it was shorter.

Not a problem at all. Since you're at the 30-day mark, I can approve this return for you right now. I'm processing the request and have just sent a pre-paid return label to the email on file. You should see it in the next few minutes.

Perfect, thank you, Diana. I appreciate you making that easy. Since I am a long-time VeloFit customer and had to deal with that website issue, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase? I'm thinking of trying one of your smart scales instead.

That is an excellent question. Given the system error you encountered and your loyalty as a VIP customer, I can absolutely do that for you. As a thank you for your patience, I've just added a 20% discount coupon to your account. It's valid for the next six months on any VeloFit product.
Wow, 20% is very generous. Thank you so much, that's a fantastic solution. I'll look for that email with the label.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been very helpful.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
